critique.evidence: Strong, cohesive cyber-defense art direction: disciplined near-black palette, cyan/yellow status accents, bold editorial headline, and the radar/vault illustration create a clear identity. Desktop and tablet hierarchy is polished, but the desktop hero has excessive unused space and the evidence panel feels visually detached. Mobile degrades into a long, cramped stack with very small, low-contrast metadata, awkward headline wrapping, and dense evidence rows. The mobile header also loses the brand name and red-mode control while exposing a clipped horizontal navigation rail; contrast proof remains incomplete for 12 header links on mobile and one on tablet.
critique.fix: Tighten the desktop hero-to-panel spacing, raise secondary-text contrast and minimum type size, and redesign the mobile evidence area into fewer progressive-disclosure cards. Give the mobile header an intentional compact state with persistent brand recognition, a clear menu/current-section treatment, and access to Red Mode without clipped navigation.
